name: Second Restart
source:
Koi no Mebaeta Toki is an introduction for never released Second Restart game.
It gives a layout of events one year before the main story and provides introduction to the characters. Situation is shown from the viewpoint of main heroine.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《Koi no Mebaeta Toki》是一款从未发行的《Second Restart》游戏的介绍。
它给出了主要故事发生前一年的事件布局，并提供了人物介绍。情况是从女主角的角度来表现的。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-august-2008-koisuru-otome.html]vndbreview[/url]]
